game.title: Debit or Credit?
game.intro: Sixty seconds of double-entry drill. An account and the way it moves appear — call the side it posts to.
game.rule_debit: Assets & expenses rise on the debit side
game.rule_credit: Liabilities, equity & income rise on the credit side
game.prompt: Which side does it post to?

term.title: Term of the Day
term.description: A quick accounting refresher, one term at a time.

accrual.name: Accrual
accrual.definition: Recording revenue or expense when it is earned or incurred, not when cash changes hands.

deferral.name: Deferral
deferral.definition: Postponing recognition of cash already received or paid until the related revenue or expense belongs to the period.

contra_account.name: Contra Account
contra_account.definition: An account that offsets a related account, such as accumulated depreciation against a fixed asset.

double_entry.name: Double Entry
double_entry.definition: Every transaction posts equal debits and credits, so the accounting equation always stays in balance.

trial_balance.name: Trial Balance
trial_balance.definition: A list of every ledger balance used to check that total debits equal total credits before preparing statements.

depreciation.name: Depreciation
depreciation.definition: Spreading the cost of a long-lived asset over the years it is expected to be useful.

working_capital.name: Working Capital
working_capital.definition: Current assets minus current liabilities — the short-term funds available to run day-to-day operations.

fifo.name: FIFO
fifo.definition: First-in, first-out: the earliest stock purchased is treated as the first sold when costing inventory.
